body:
Red-team review and one-shot replanning completed against original saved revision rv_01m4fret0yedczpew0fba4bzv3, hash sha256:26e5921d87b03727e63ee9d5752d9e66bc42e37c856eb314fba99a9bc5a806b4. Target was the plan, not an implemented mod. Lenses: principal (contracts/invariants), product (consumer promises/ownership), code (Dark Mechanicus execution mechanics). Code/content/gamer runtime audits were not represented as performed where the mod/output artifacts do not exist. Root owns integration and persistence.

Verified findings and corrections:
1. Nine human checkpoints plus MMR-21/23/55/56 approval wording defeated a one-shot attempt. Consolidated to one sprint, 57 work tickets, one final acceptance with 57 unique covers. Removed intermediate architecture/content/budget approvals, preserving actual capability checks. continue_independent prevents whole-run pausing after an exhausted ticket; retryLimit=3 counts failed/rejected/reconciled-expired attempts. Descendants remain blocked on real failures; neither this review nor the planner grants host approvals/additional retries.
2. MMR-9/10/11 required the product document that MMR-11 creates, and MMR-12/13 could start before it existed. Removed that must-read metadata for these five; added MMR-11->14 for actual later consumers. Removed MMR-21->22, added MMR-15->22 and MMR-21->25, and removed backend-decision inputs from MMR-22/23/24. Independent producer/protocol/parser/identity work no longer waits on unrelated engine proof. Working probe code is promoted instead of duplicated.
3. MMR-11/27/31/32 reopened authorized official-template reuse and source settlement limits as product approvals. Replaced with versioned implementer-owned mappings and mechanical validity checks; missing custom fantasy art is not a stop. F03 now owns a diagnostic size-129 full-globe recipe with expanded pinned inputs, three visible deterministic quality attempts, and a fixed Seed/Random World/Generate -> preview -> Start Campaign flow. C05/C06/P06 own bounded normal-start/port/naval access. Diagnostic funds/fleet setup is recorded and cannot substitute for real purchase/embark evidence.
4. Epic s7 and P02/P04/Q01-Q03/Q05 demanded release certification before a first playable test. The required final scenario now exercises A/B full generated worlds, land/naval travel, missions/raids, player+AI E/W routes/proximity/camera/picking, same-process and cold-restart saves, one cancellation, invalid copied-world recovery and local packaging. Broad 20-seed/five-world coverage, three 100-day soaks, ten-cycle endurance and broad profile certification are explicitly follow-up/not-run. Any observed correctness failure remains failed; feature scope was not removed.
5. MMR-27 ambiguously both rejected unresolved game mappings and deferred their owners to C02-C04. It now resolves source identities/categories/joins into typed policy slots; C02-C04 resolve concrete game values and C07 rejects every required remaining slot. Static/compiler policy identity remains immutable; resolving policy snapshots join RuntimeDerivedBundle identity. ActivationReceipt binds both and load uses frozen policies. This was a plan ambiguity, not a proven code cycle or engine defect.

Evidence executed: three read-only reviews parsed the pinned saved bundle and cited ticket bodies/criteria/requiredArtifacts. Code lens inspected actual Dark Mechanicus source predicates, supported draft ops and checkpoint authorization. Central verification invoked node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs C:/Users/davgo/AppData/Local/Temp/mnbl-redteam-integrate.ts from the DM source checkout, using owning draftOps schema/applyDraftOps/validatePlan/groupIntoRows/computeExecution, not a reimplemented scheduler. Candidate: one sprint,57 work,one acceptance,121 edges,57 covers,zero errors/warnings. A positive control accepting all57 made final acceptance ready. A failure control on the original two-failure budget yielded one failed,55 blocked,two independently ready; continue_independent is not unlimited retry. Live installed MCP validation of the revised draft also returned zero errors/warnings. Counts and contract edits were independently rechecked by different lenses. Final correction removed a stale rationale paragraph requiring Sprint8/9 budget approvals, caught by two lenses.

Adversarial review and limitations: no generator build, game launch, mod implementation, performance benchmark or actual execution run was performed. Size129 and template/backend choices are proposed starting decisions, not proven engine support or guarantees. Source-only DM behavior was checked against live installed validation for plan shape; no claim that matching-version source is byte-identical to installed code. Actual runtime support, host permissions and unavailable dependencies can still block dependent implementation.

Dropped/corrected claims: principal found no missing original phase dependency chains and narrowed a suspected semantic cycle to wording ambiguity. Seed-width mismatch was refuted by pinned request_json.cpp accepting uint32; the separate uint64 layout seed remains text. Culture/naval/save features already had owners; product narrowed naval concern to bounded access for the first test. Existing engine APIs were already correctly labeled candidates. Code lens corrected its initial assumption that every work ticket stores kind; the owning predicate treats omitted kind as work. Automatic checkpoints alone cannot bypass desktop auto-continue authorization, so the revision uses one final human checkpoint instead. Supported remove_sprint removes redundant acceptance nodes; no direct record/DB edits were used.

RT1 independent review accepted. RT2 findings integrated and bounded correction reviews passed after the one stale-paragraph fix. RT3 one-shot execution/acceptance preserved with fewer approval stops. RT4 live saved revision/readback verification follows this comment; the implementation epic stays backlog with no active run.
